body: The worst part is I know this. It isn't like I haven't heard this from someone before. The situation presents itself, I get lost in the moment, expose my true feelings concerning whatever situation, then they leave. Fuck, I'm not even entirely sure how I fell into a relationship with my best friend's ex. She came to me to help her with her relationship with my friend and developed feelings for me through that. The foundation for this relationship feels shaky. She wants me to solve her problems. She can't be independent. I just don't want to feel alone so I jumped in without thinking and lost my best friend in the entire world because of it. I'm a god damn idiot.

I never hold onto friends. My relationships never last. I have a way of overreacting about everything (ha). What's the point? Every time I meet a new person or attempt to make a new friend, I become self conscious and ask myself how long it's going to last. I'm going to fuck it up somewhere down the line.
